fields.summary_ko.0: Goldman Sachs adjusted Samsung Electronics target price from KRW 500,000 to KRW 350,000 (30% downward), SK Hynix from KRW 3.5 million to KRW 2 million (43% downward).
fields.summary_ko.1: With increased memory semiconductor supply in 2028, DRAM and NAND prices are each expected to decline 20%, with both companies' 2028 operating profit forecasts revised down 26% and 23% respectively.
fields.summary_ko.2: The HBM market is expected to grow from $60 billion this year to $237 billion by 2028, but cannot offset the decline in commodity memory prices.
